description: You are a compliance engineer performing a security audit for a regulated industry client. The existing Wazuh Security Configuration Assessment (SCA) already runs CIS Benchmark policies, but your client requires additional organization-specific security checks not covered by the default CIS policies. Complete all of the following: (1) Review the current SCA scan results in the Wazuh dashboard to understand the existing compliance posture and identify gaps; (2) Create a custom SCA policy YAML file (using Wazuh's SCA YAML schema) that defines at least 3 company-specific security configuration checks covering areas such as SSH hardening (root login, key-only auth), password policy enforcement, audit logging daemon status, or firewall/iptables rules; (3) Configure Wazuh to execute this custom policy alongside existing policies — the policy file must be placed in Wazuh's configuration directory and the manager must be made aware of it; (4) Write a compliance gap analysis report to /home/ga/Desktop/compliance_report.txt that documents: what SCA checks were reviewed, the custom policy you created (including the policy name and what each check verifies), and specific remediation recommendations for the gaps found. The report must be at least 500 characters long. Dashboard: admin/SecretPassword at https://localhost. API: wazuh-wui/MyS3cr37P450r.*- at https://localhost:55000.

metadata.description: Create custom SCA policy with 3+ checks, configure Wazuh, write compliance gap analysis report
